name: 2-Slice Stainless Steel Toaster
description: This sleek stainless steel toaster offers two wide slots for bagels and thick bread, with six browning settings for personalized crispness. The high-lift lever makes retrieval easy, and the crumb tray slides out for hassle-free cleaning. Compact enough for any countertop.
shortDescription: A stainless steel toaster with customizable browning.

reviews.title: Decent toaster but uneven browning
reviews.comment: The stainless-steel body looks sleek and fits nicely on my countertop. The 2-slice slots are roomy, but the browning control is a bit inconsistent, leaving one slice darker than the other. Overall it works, just not as reliably as I hoped.

reviews.title: Perfect compact toaster for daily use
reviews.comment: I love the brushed stainless steel finish; it adds a modern touch to my kitchen. The 2-slice capacity is perfect for quick breakfasts, and the adjustable browning dial gives exactly the toast I want every time. The removable crumb tray makes cleaning a breeze, and the cancel button is a handy safety feature.

reviews.title: Disappointing performance and flimsy construction
reviews.comment: The toaster's stainless steel exterior feels cheap and scratches easily. The heating elements take too long to toast even a single slice, and the crumb tray is too shallow to catch all the crumbs. For the price, I expected a sturdier 2-slice toaster.

reviews.title: Reliable toast every morning, highly recommend
reviews.comment: This 2-slice stainless steel toaster delivers consistent results with its precise browning control. The slots accommodate bagels and thick bread without issue, and the pop-up mechanism works smoothly. Cleaning is simple thanks to the easy-slide crumb tray, and the sleek design complements any kitchen décor.

reviews.title: Good looks but average toasting
reviews.comment: The brushed stainless steel finish looks great on my counter, and the compact size is a plus. However, the toaster sometimes burns the edges while leaving the center under-done, even on the lightest setting. It's okay for occasional use, but I wish the browning control were more reliable.
